# netbox_vlan_group (Resource)


> A VLAN Group represents a collection of VLANs. Generally, these are limited by one of a number of scopes such as "Site" or "Virtualization Cluster".

## Example Usage

```terraform
#Basic VLAN Group example
resource "netbox_vlan_group" "example1" {
  name = "example1"
  slug = "example1"
}

#Full VLAN Group example
resource "netbox_vlan_group" "example2" {
  name        = "Second Example"
  slug        = "example2"
  scope_type  = "dcim.site"
  scope_id    = netbox_site.example.id
  description = "Second Example VLAN Group"
  tags        = [netbox_tag.example.id]
  vid_ranges  = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the vlan group.
- `slug` (String) The URL-friendly slug of the vlan group.
- `vid_ranges` (List of List of Number) The vid ranges of the vlan group.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the vlan group.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the vlan group. Defaults to `""`.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the vlan group.
- `scope_id` (Number) The ID of the scope associated with the vlan group. Required when `scope_type` is set.
- `scope_type` (String) Valid values are `dcim.location`, `dcim.site`, `dcim.sitegroup`, `dcim.region`, `dcim.rack`, `virtualization.cluster` and `virtualization.clustergroup`.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the vlan group.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_vlan_group.example 1
```
